verdict.rationale: Marqeta's sandbox explicitly provides /simulations/cardtransactions/* endpoints to simulate authorizations, reversals, clearings, and other network transaction events, and the quick-start tutorial walks developers through creating sandbox objects and simulating transactions before going live; velocity/authorization controls let developers test decline logic. missing for 10: explicit named simulation endpoints for refunds/declines as distinct event types (only 'authorizations, reversals, and balance inquiries' explicitly named) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the full lifecycle simulation working end-to-end.
